A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study, and their complete main texts, figures, equations and appendices support comparison. The new Appendix B and the renumbered existing appendices can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v3 reports original activation-patching experiments on multilingual translation and definition generation, with additional model comparisons and diagnostic experiments in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including translation probabilities, definition-similarity scores and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The patching procedures, cross-language averaging and definition-generation setup are retained. TPcollect and DPcollect become TPconcept and DPconcept without procedural changes. Algorithm 1 documents construction of existing experimental pairs.

E1.justification: The distinct translation and definition-generation datasets, languages and scenarios are retained. Figure 10 removes duplicate panels while preserving all four distinct language configurations.

E2.justification: The definition comparisons retain Prompting, Word Patching and Repeat Word alongside the same patching variants. The single-source, mean-over-contexts and mean-over-language-pairs comparisons also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Figure 12 changes its model label from 'Gemma-2 2B' to 'Gemma 2B', while the introduction and Figure 13 retain 'Gemma 2 2B'. The unchanged plots and absent explanation leave uncertain whether this corrects the evaluated model designation or merely shortens its name. Other settings match; Appendix B supplies documentation rather than reporting a protocol revision.

E4.justification: The Patchscope diagnostic, randomized and modified prompt tests, context-averaging control, and alternative definition-loss analysis are all retained. Renumbering the appendices and deduplicating Figure 10 do not add or remove analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same means and 95% confidence intervals, including Gaussian intervals over the translation prompt pairs. No repeated-run counts, seeds, significance tests or uncertainty-estimation procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: The matched plots retain their numerical curves, bars and uncertainty bounds, and the reported empirical findings are unchanged. Figure 10 removes three exact duplicate panels without losing any distinct result.

T1.justification: The residual-stream equation, concept/token definitions, subspace decomposition, H1/H2 hypotheses and averaging argument are unchanged. Added explanations of conditional-probability notation and negative indexing do not revise the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract and five principal contributions are retained. However, the introduction newly claims the first causal analysis/direct evidence of active use of language-agnostic representations, and the conclusion adds a claim of mechanistic insight into Western cultural bias.

C2.justification: The conclusion adds interpretations concerning bias propagation through shared concept spaces and potential training-efficiency benefits. The new discussion of Fierro et al. contrasts translation with the opposite processing order in factual recall. The existing limitations concerning simple and language-specific concepts remain unchanged.

D1.justification: New Appendix B and Algorithm 1 document translation-pair enumeration, shuffling, filtering and selection, with a notebook pointer. v4 also replaces the anonymous code link with a named GitHub repository and explains missing BabelNet definitions. These are additional reproducibility disclosures.

R1.justification: v4 adds definition-modeling literature, discusses concurrent work by Fierro et al., expands cross-lingual citations and discloses the workshop precursor. It removes the Anonymous 2024 citation. These changes broaden the positioning around the retained research objective.

P1.justification: Prompt-design explanations are reorganized and supplemented with examples, terminology is renamed, and introductory and concluding paragraphs are added. A new appendix shifts existing appendix labels; copyediting and affiliation updates accompany these limited structural changes.

P2.justification: Figure 10 changes from seven panels to a compact arrangement of four unique panels with a clearer caption. v4 adds the Algorithm 1 display and adjusts figure placement, captions and the Gemma label. The underlying diagrams and result graphics are retained.

improvement.justification: Appendix B makes the previously terse pair-selection procedure easier to reproduce, while clearer prompt examples, expanded research context and Figure 10's deduplication improve readability. The empirical evidence remains unchanged. The unexplained Gemma label and untested cultural-bias interpretation limit, but do not outweigh, these modest documentation and presentation gains.
